cited.quote: this Government will continue to urge the Union Government to declare Tamil, as one of the official languages of India

rationale: C1 (Governor's address) states an intention to continue urging the Union to declare Tamil an official language; it is a statement of intent, not a formal step such as an Assembly resolution, CM letter or GO. C2-C5 show no such step.
No extract mentions a seabridge between Chennai Port and Thiruvottriyur; C1-C2 are a Thiruvallur bypass ROB, C3 Kanyakumari port limits, C4 a SIPCOT approach road DPR, C5 industrial parks.
C1, C2, C4, C5 are lists of private hospitals empanelled under employee/pensioner health insurance; C3 revises paying-patient rates. None concerns upgrading District Hospital facilities for the poor.
C1 and C4 are bonded-labour procedures, C2-C3 the general employee health insurance scheme, C5 medical attendance rates. None is about free treatment for police injured on duty.
No extract concerns amending the Damage to Public Property Act; C1/C5 are audit findings, C2-C3 unrelated rule amendments, C4 environmental budget plans.
None of C1-C5 concerns featuring folk arts in Government events (library events, agriculture museum, Governor's address, a commission, land records).

cited.quote: 647 works at a total cost of Rs.65.11 crore covering 9 districts have been taken up and completed
all irrigation channels were taken up for timely desilting at a cost of Rs. 65.11 crore for 647 works

rationale: C1 and C4 report delta-wide special desilting of channels across Cauvery delta districts, but no extract names the Thanjavur stone dam area or a dredging/desilting step specific to it, and no dated GO is given. Broader related activity only.
No extract mentions the Salem Saanarpatti-Moolakkadu irrigation project; C1-C5 concern sugar mills, TNAU projects and budget schemes elsewhere.
No extract shows the state urging the Union Government to withdraw any committee's recommendations; C1-C5 concern DPC procedure, a land-exchange committee, water issues and minimum wages.
No extract concerns issuing caste and income certificates to students in schools; C1-C2 list school services, C3 a scholarship portal, C4 the revised SC list, C5 budget allocations.

cited.quote: The Vision Document for a New Dawn also envisages extension of the Wage Employment Programme to Urban areas

rationale: C5 launches a state-funded urban employment scheme and C1 a state KNMT scheme for municipalities; these are state schemes on a related subject, not a formal step urging the Union to extend its scheme to municipalities.
C1-C4 appoint Right to Information officers and C5 concerns disability equal-opportunity policy; no extract is about a Right to Services Act.

cited.quote: SIPCOT is in the process of setting up of 60 MLD Desalination Plant
The 400 MLD Desalination Plant will be expeditiously implemented with JICA assistance.

rationale: C2 is a budget statement about the Chennai plant; C1 reports a SIPCOT plant for industrial water at Thoothukudi still in process, a different purpose and beneficiaries. No official step extending the desalination project to other coastal areas.

cited.quote: other part-time employees like Sanitary Workers, Over Head Tank / Power Pump Operators drawing consolidated pay / honorarium

rationale: C2/C4 enhance the group insurance lumpsum for all local body and aided-institution employees, including part-time sanitary workers; a broader measure, not one dedicated to the promised employment, salary and pension commitments for sanitary workers. C1/C3 are an urban employment scheme.
No extract concerns a Museum of Tamil History and Culture in Sivagangai; C1 is an agriculture museum in Chennai, C2 excavation funding, C3-C5 unrelated.
C1-C3 concern subsidised distribution and custom hiring of farm machinery, C4-C5 unrelated; none is about a farm machinery manufacturing plant in Erode.

cited.quote: The scheme for distribution of free school uniforms for children from classes 1 to 8 will be implemented with supplies from powerlooms

rationale: C2 is a budget statement of intent that uniforms will be supplied from powerlooms and weaving units; no GO or official step awarding uniform contracts exclusively to powerloom weavers. C1 only describes uniform distribution.

cited.quote: Necessary steps will be taken to expedite the Maduravoyal to Chennai Port elevated road project

rationale: C4 states an intention to expedite one Chennai elevated road; no extract shows an official step for elevated highways in Chennai, Kovai, Madurai, Trichy or Nellai. C1-C3, C5 concern other road works and budget plans.
C1 and C4 describe library services and compassionate appointments, C2-C3 law college librarian qualifications, C5 MGNREGS rates; none concerns interim jobs for rural librarians.

cited.quote: To ensure remunerative price to farmers who cultivate minor millets, vegetable, fruits, etc.

rationale: C3 lists dryland development and remunerative prices for millet growers as agriculture budget targets only; no GO or scheme providing cash incentives to dryland millet farmers. C1-C2 are MSME incentives, C5 a sugarcane incentive.
